data.text:
The #1 AI Assistant For Your Meetings
Transcribe, summarize, search, and analyze all your team conversations.
USED ACROSS 1 MILLION+ COMPANIES

High Quality Meeting Transcription & Recording
Fireflies is the industry leader in transcription accuracy, achieving 95% accuracy. It transcribes meetings in 100+ languages, including English, Spanish, French, and several others, with auto-language detection for seamless switching. Fireflies also features Speaker Recognition, identifying different speakers in meetings and audio files.

Comprehensive AI Summaries
Get comprehensive AI meeting summaries and the ability to expand summary notes.

Capture Meetings Anywhere & Anytime
Fireflies offers multiple ways to capture your conversations:
*   **AI Note Taker Bot:** Invite fred@fireflies.ai to a live meeting or have it autojoin your calendar meetings to record, transcribe, and summarize.
*   **Chrome Extension:** Automatically record your Google Meet calls and get real-time transcripts.
*   **Mobile App:** Transcribe and summarize in-person conversations.
*   **Desktop App:** Transcribe and summarize your calls.
*   **Dialers & API:** Transcribe calls from Aircall, Ringcentral, and other dialers, or use our API to process audio files.
*   **Audio & Video Files:** Transcribe audio and video files (MP3, MP4, WAV, M4A) with AI meeting summaries.

Remember Every Conversation with AI Powered Search
Remember what was discussed on calls several months ago down to the specific sentence and timestamp.
*   **Meeting Search:** Easily find past conversations.
*   **AskFred:** Let Fred review your meetings and come back with answers to any question you have.
*   **AI Filters:** Apply filters to refine your search.

Get real-time suggestions, coaching, and answers during meetings.
Meet the new Live Assist that can provide real-time suggestions, coaching, and answers during your meetings.

Drive Insights With Conversation Intelligence
Understand what’s happening across the company and what your team needs to get done.
*   **Speaker Talk-time:** Automatically track each participant's speaking time and easily monitor participation in meetings.
*   **Sentiment Analysis:** Analyze the sentiment of conversations.
*   **Topic Trackers:** Track specific topics discussed.

Go Beyond Notetaking with 200+ AI Skills
AI Skills help you automatically extract key details, generate follow-up emails, score candidates, and other insights from your meetings.

Meeting Intelligence with Fireflies MCP
Keep all your Tasks, Contacts, & Knowledge in one place.

Other Key Features:
*   Download Meetings
*   Soundbites
*   Channels
*   User Groups
*   Comments & Bookmarks

Integrate Fireflies with your favorite Work Tools
Integrate Fireflies with your favorite work tools, including:
*   **CRM:** Salesforce, Hubspot
*   **Project Management:** Asana, Trello
*   **ATS:** Lever, BambooHR
*   **Communication:** Slack
*   **AI Tools:** Connects with Claude, Anthropic, Devin, and other AI tools.

Enterprise-grade Security
Fireflies follows industry standards for data security, privacy, and confidentiality.

Your privacy
*   **Compliance:** Rigorous data protection and privacy standards in line with SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, and HIPAA Compliant regulations.
*   **Data Usage:** Your data is never used for AI training or any purpose outside your direct business needs.
*   **Data Retention:** Zero Data Retention policy.
*   **Storage:** Secure, dedicated Private Storage exclusively for your organization’s data.
*   **Ownership:** You maintain full control and ownership of your data, explicitly stated in our Term of Service.

Don't Take Our Word For It
See why thousands of organizations are switching to Fireflies:
*   “Fireflies brought more structure in our meetings and more transparency within our company.”
*   “Impressed by Fireflies' analytics. It helps tracks my team conversations.”
*   “Fireflies cuts down on additional calls with customers, letting us focus directly on solutions.”
*   “Super impressed with how Fireflies helps us analyze what our customers actually need!”
